title: eludite.debug.run_until input
description: Get the debuggee from here to there in one call: set breakpoints at `points` (temporary ones by default, shown in the Breakpoints window while they exist), resume, and answer with the next visible stop, whatever its reason (one of the points, another breakpoint, an exception, the end of the session), as Run To Cursor does; the temporary points are removed at that stop. Prefer it to stepping line by line: one round trip instead of one per line. A line that already has a breakpoint keeps it. Refused unless the debuggee is in break mode. The answer is the stop summary (debug-stop-summary.output.json) within the budget parameters; on a timeout `mode` is `running` with `timed_out` (the points stay until the next stop), and after the session ends `design` with `exit_code` and `message`. Next: read `stopped.location`, then eludite.debug.variables or another run_until.
x-eludite-escalates: Dangerous when the solution's policy sets `debug.drive` to `prompt`; refused for agents when it sets `debug.drive` to `deny`.

path.description: The source file (absolute or relative to the solution folder).

condition.description: Stop at this point only when this C# expression is true.

remove_after.description: Remove the points at the next visible stop (default true). False keeps them as ordinary breakpoints.

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the next stop or the end of the session, in milliseconds (default 5000, at most 30000).

stop.description: The stop the caller saw (`stop` in eludite.debug.state). When given and the debuggee has stopped or resumed since, the command is refused as stale instead of acting on a state the caller did not see (two drivers, PLAN.md 5.5).

depth.description: How many levels of the locals to expand: 1 (default) lists the top level only; up to 5. Expansion is breadth-first and stops when `max_variables` rows are listed.

max_variables.description: The most variable rows listed, counting every level (default 50, at most 500).

max_value_chars.description: Values longer than this are cut and end with `… (N chars)`, the row saying `value_truncated` (default 200, at most 10000).

max_frames.description: The most stack frames listed (default 10, at most 200); page further with eludite.debug.stack.

max_output_lines.description: The most program output lines listed (default 20, at most 1000; 0 lists none).

output_since.description: An output cursor (`output.next` of an earlier answer, or eludite.debug.output's `next`): list the program's lines from it on. Default: the last `max_output_lines` lines.
